svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Side elevations to scale, 80 px = 1 m, front to the right. Colours are the Tin Finch's: pale blue, cream, faded red over steel. Shapes are blocks for proportion only, not art.
1 Car on tyres: nose engine · two-seat cab · second engine · camp deck
0.96 m tyres (0.46 m rims, 0.25 m sidewall), 3.6 m wheelbase, 0.42 m under the frame
2 Car on tracks: nose engine · one-seat cab, another stacked · camper shell
the same chassis; two track units take the four hubs; a second level on roofs that carry load
track units on the same four hubs
two levels at most; the tallest build stays under 3.9 m
3 Motorbike: frame · single engine · tyres · seat · rack (sidecar dashed)
0.80 m front and 0.76 m rear tyres, 1.52 m wheelbase, 0.95 m seat, 0.32 m under the frame
snow kit (dashed): a ski for the front tyre, a track for the rear
the same 1.8 m person; the left is the look the owner rejected, the right is ours
body hangs over it, no visible travel
ours: 0.96 m tyre, half its radius rubber
knobs proud, open arch, the spring seen
Rules: tyre ≥ 0.53 × the person's height on a car (0.44 on the bike); sidewall ≥ 0.25 × diameter;
the arch clears full bump and full steering lock; the wheel's top edge stands above the frame.
